story_info.title: Bella Bear Welcomes a New Friend
story_info.subtitle: Kindness by Crystal Lake
story_info.moral: Being kind and welcoming makes everyone happy.

main_character.name: Bella Bear
main_character.appearance: Bella is a small, round brown bear cub with soft honey-colored fur, warm dark eyes, and a gentle smile. She has a little cream-colored tummy patch and short rounded ears.

supporting_characters.name: Chirp
supporting_characters.appearance: A small blue bird with a yellow chest and tiny orange feet.
supporting_characters.role: A new friend who feels shy and needs a welcome.

slides.title: A New Face by the Lake
slides.text: Bella Bear was near Crystal Lake. The morning sun was bright. She saw a little blue bird. The bird sat quietly on a big rock. It looked a bit shy and sad. Bella smiled her gentle smile. "Kind hearts make happy days!" she thought. She knew how to help new friends feel happy and safe in Wonderwood Valley.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Bella at Crystal Lake and the new, shy bird.

slides.title: Hello, Chirp!
slides.text: Bella walked slowly towards the bird. "Hello!" she said softly. "Are you new here?" The little bird, Chirp, nodded. Chirp chirped a very small, quiet sound. "My home is far away," Chirp said. "I do not know anyone here. I feel a little bit lost." Bella understood.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella gently talks to Chirp, who explains why they are sad.

slides.title: Sharing Happy Places
slides.text: Bella thought for a moment. "It is okay, Chirp!" she said. "I can show you special places." She pointed a paw. "See the pretty flowers near the water? We can find the sweetest berries there!" Chirp looked at Bella. A tiny smile started on Chirp's beak. Bella knew sharing a happy activity helps.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella offers to show Chirp around and find berries.

slides.title: Exploring Together
slides.text: Bella and Chirp walked by the lake. Chirp saw colourful fish swimming. Bella showed Chirp a big, strong tree. "This tree has soft leaves for a cozy nest," Bella said. Chirp chirped a happy song this time. Bella shared a juicy berry she found. They sat and ate together.
slides.speaker_notes: They explore the lake and share a berry, Chirp starts to feel happier.

slides.title: A Warm Welcome
slides.text: Chirp felt warm and happy with Bella. "Thank you, Bella!" Chirp said. "You are very kind." Bella hugged Chirp gently. "Kind hearts make happy days!" she said. Chirp now had a new friend and felt safe in Wonderwood Valley. They knew they would play together again very soon.
slides.speaker_notes: Chirp feels welcomed and happy, Bella's kindness shines through.
